programme.desc: 这一趟到南投，威廉、小舜相揪到鱼池chill一下！威哥带着小舜一起到鱼池享受熟男行程，从绝美人气咖啡厅一路chill到底！甚至把五星料理搬上游艇，用全新视角畅游日月潭！两人逛伊达绍老街，一路遇粉丝老板热情招待，超美味总统鱼酥卷，不用进大餐厅就能吃的到！拳头大的高丽菜包让怕烫的威哥大口吃！鱼池这里竟然有媲美荷兰羊角村的美景？还有会跳舞的土地，让威廉差点深陷泥沼？！千万不要错过，更多精彩内容请锁定东森超视33频道周日晚间8点「效廉 出发吧！」。

programme.title: Earth S01
programme.desc: Chris Packham tells the miraculous story of how plant life turned Earth from a barren rock into a vibrant green world - a four-billion year saga of extraordinary highs and lows that almost wiped out all life on the planet. Beginning as a water world without land masses, a giant asteroid bombardment triggered Earth's plate tectonics, leading to huge fungi, soil and giant swamp forests. But the early plants locked so much carbon dioxide that global temperatures suddenly plunged.

programme.title: 魔剑侠情

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns to the screen with this seriocomic look at the clash of cultures which result when a Mainland Chinese peasant brings his family to Hong Kong. Family Light Affair, whose Chinese title literally translates as "City Lights", is the director/writer's warm-hearted memoir of street life back in the early 1980s, featuring an eclectic cast of pop music and kung fu stars who shine in their poignant roles.

programme.title: 城市之光
programme.desc: 导演张坚庭在本片体现香港八十年代的大城小景；陈友与妻子惠英红从大陆来港投靠父亲，却发现他并非如信中所言生活富足。东方之珠的美梦换来悲喜交集。

programme.title: The Winged Tiger
programme.desc: If the two big villains Winged Tiger and Underworld King join forces, the martial arts world will be plunged into chaos. This evil union is set to occur with the marriage of the Underworld King's sister and the Winged Tiger. Can this dangerous duo be stopped before one says "I do"?

programme.title: 插翅虎
programme.desc: 若结合武林两大魔头，插翅虎及活阎王，的武功，他们必定独霸武林，江湖又将有一轮腥风血雨。活阎王为促成这个邪恶联盟，决将胞妹嫁给插翅虎。究竟最后二人之毒计会否得逞？谁可挽救一场武林浩劫？

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung meets a famous courtesan in Suzhou and in order to spend as much time as possible with her, he builds a direct underground tunnel into the Forbidden City. The emperor's sudden appearances through this direct access shock his people but it is also at this time that he helps the needy and cracks the gambling business in Suzhou.

programme.title: 乾隆皇与三姑娘
programme.desc: 乾隆皇爱慕苏州名妓三姑娘，为了朝夕幽会，竟然在青楼挖了一条地下通道直达紫禁城。青楼内外，乾隆神出鬼没，吓破臣下的胆子。乾隆在民间行侠仗义，更在赌坊大破赌局。

programme.title: Five Shaolin Masters
programme.desc: The Qing court plots to kill all Shaolin disciples by burning down Shaolin Temple. This sudden fire killed almost everyone except for five disciples. To take revenge on the Qing court, the five of them train hard in different fighting styles to become "The Five Shaolin Masters".

programme.title: 少林五祖
programme.desc: 将少林寺视为眼中钉的清廷，处心积虑地想一举消灭少林子弟，于是火烧少林寺。事出突然，寺中僧人及俗家弟子十死其九。其中五名生还弟子，决意为死去的少林弟子报仇。五人潜心修炼终成正果，被后世称为"少林五祖"。

programme.title: Mr. Funnybone Strikes Again
programme.desc: In this hilarious sequel, Mr Big Potato opens an old-fashioned Chinese clinic, but his traditional methods are rejected by the sceptics of modern Hong Kong. Enter his buddy Mr Funny bone to rescue his business!

programme.title: 老夫子奇趣录
programme.desc: 电影承上集继续笑料百出。这次，大蕃薯开了一家中医诊所，但传统的中医似乎不为时髦的香港社会接受。最后得靠好友老夫子相助，为他解决疑难！

programme.title: Black Magic
programme.desc: Hsu Lo is up against an evil black magic practitioner San Kan Mi, who wants to place a death spell on him and a love spell on his fiancee Wang Chu Ying. Fortunately, Wang's friends manage to find another veteran witch doctor to take on the evil San. This bone-chilling tale of good versus evil races to a heart-stopping ending.

programme.title: 降头
programme.desc: 狄龙剧中为一准新郎，但却遇上心术不正的恬妮单恋痴缠，更借助邪术降头，务求夺取男方欢心。后恬妮裙下之臣罗烈及狄龙未婚妻，亦相继加入战团。一场因为爱而生与死的斗争，复杂的关系加上正邪大斗法，将人性为达一己私欲的恶行，表露无遗。至于邪是否不能胜正？且看结局便有分晓。

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barber's apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy.

programme.title: 一乐也
programme.desc: 由三个民初故事串联而成的喜剧小品，许冠文一人分饰多角，其中包括剃头学徒：有一街坊中风而死，许代师傅守灵，为打发时间与众人在灵堂玩起「麻雀耍乐」，怎料尸体突然触电翻生！

programme.title: Till the End of Time
programme.desc: Ming marries singer Ling, defying his wealthy father and severing family ties. When Ling becomes pregnant, Ming's overwork causes him to lose his sight. To support their home, Ling returns to the stage but Ming leaves to avoid becoming a burden. Encouraged by a friend, Ling performs again, and her song moves Ming to reunite with his wife and child.

programme.title: 何日君再来
programme.desc: 富家子卓明不顾父亲反对，与歌女雪玲结婚，并因此与家庭断绝关系。婚后，雪玲怀孕，卓明因过度劳累导致视力衰退。为维持家计，雪玲重操旧业登台演唱，而卓明不愿拖累妻子，选择悄然离开。在友人鼓励下，雪玲再次公开献唱，卓明深受感动，最终与妻儿重逢。

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

programme.title: 阿牛入城记
programme.desc: 这部喜剧描述乡下人阿牛来港后，因生性戆直而经常被坏人利用。阿牛尝尽低下层社会的人情冷暖，最后更被判入狱！究竟天生乐观的他，能否吉人天相？

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back...

programme.title: 我为你狂
programme.desc: 的士司机阿发与少女阿霞相爱已久，但发有神经错乱，霞为除心理负担，忍痛分手; 发大闹霞家并断指示真心，令霞感动而复合。然发却不务正业，令霞甚为反感;一次争执间，发狂性大发，霞流产，再次离开发...

programme.title: The Magnificent Ruffians
programme.desc: Renowned martial arts clan heir Yuan Ying Fei hires four down-and-out martial artists to eliminate the local escort agency's young chief, Guan Yuan. Unexpectedly, the four befriend Guan instead. When Yuan's conspiracy leads to Guan's death, they unite to avenge him.

programme.title: 卖命小子
programme.desc: 武林名门世家子弟袁鹰飞为了对付虎威镖局少镖头关云，拉拢四位失意江湖高手对付他。岂料四人与关云不打不相识，反成好友。后袁鹰飞设下毒计害死关云，四人悲愤交集，遂联手为友复仇。

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung goes incognito to mix with his people and understand their needs. He encounters many strange things along the way, including being arrested and nearly beheaded. Who will save him?

programme.title: 乾隆皇奇遇记
programme.desc: 乾隆皇帝微服出巡，希望藉此了解百姓的生活需要，但却碰上连串的奇遇，乾隆更被衙差关进牢狱，差点要被斩首...最后又有谁可拯救皇帝出困境？

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud’s successor as the city’s guard.

programme.title: 火云邪神之修罗面具
programme.desc: 十八年前，邪恶的黑羽会潜入了老邪神西城勇的地盘，盗走了修罗面具，而利用修罗面具放出当时只是个婴儿的魔神。老邪神为了魔神日后不作恶收养了婴儿，教他好好做人，成为小邪神。小邪神最后控制了面具的力量成为老邪神的接班人，继续守护城市。

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
programme.desc: Conman Sing is forced by a loan shark to team up with another con artist Betty to steal from a luxurious house. When they encounter other conmen who disguise themselves as the house owners to steal the antiques, they pretend to be their rich guests. As both sides know the other’s true identity, they join forces to con the loan shark into a trap.

programme.title: 情圣
programme.desc: 终日偷呃拐骗的程胜被贵利王所迫，要与女骗子叶圆合谋洗劫一间豪华大宅。不料却遇上另一群骗子冒充豪宅屋主去偷取屋内的古董，程胜和叶圆唯有扮成到访的阔少和太太。当他们发现对方的真正身份后，决定一起设骗局对付贵利王。

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: 无味神探
programme.desc: 故事根据真人实事改编，讲述香港督察刘镇海个性暴躁又好色，毒枭阿军欲杀他自保，但只令海失去味觉和嗅觉。妻子不忍见丈夫负伤累累因此尽释前嫌、尽心照顾。阿军得知海幷未身亡，胁持其妻作为谈判筹码。海为了救出妻子，只身一人与毒枭展开生死决战...

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The savior of the people, Stone Monkey, has given hope to a desperate little girl which he promises to realize. Years later, Stone Monkey is defeated in a battle with the three-eyed God of War, causing him to lose his power and falls into the mortal world. Can he fulfill his promise to the girl and stop the God of Wood from destroying earth?

programme.title: 混世四猴：神猴归来
programme.desc: 世人心目中的救世主灵明石猴，曾给一位绝望中的小女孩一个从没兑现的希望，让她一直深深牵挂。直至多年后，灵明石猴在与三眼战神激战后，被打破金身堕入凡尘，因而丧失神力。灵明石猴能否补偿当年小女孩的承诺？又可会破坏木神祸乱人间的阴谋？

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: 求爱敢死队
programme.desc: 失恋的王晶认识了电台节目主持曾志伟。志伟自诩情场杀手向王晶提供追求秘诀，但当其本身周旋于妻子与情人的关系当中，却不知如何是好...

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witch—but can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: 灵幻先生
programme.desc: 江湖术士茅山明无法驱除复仇的怨灵，只得与他的鬼同伴一起逃脱。他们躲进一个村庄后，遇到了意图灭绝人类的邪恶女魔头。于是，茅山明与师父九叔携手合作，对抗这位威胁村民的魔头。他们能否战胜黑暗势力，赢得最终的胜利？

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognise.

programme.title: 冰封侠重生之门
programme.desc: 明朝锦衣卫贺英被诬陷为弑君逆贼，三位结义兄弟奉命追杀。在生死对决之际，四人意外被冰封于时空裂隙。四百年后，他们在现代香港苏醒。一场跨越时代的宿命之战，于陌生都市再度引爆。

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair…

programme.title: 替枪老豆
programme.desc: 万与夏婚后多年忽想生育，但万被证实不育，让夏接受人工受孕；但万心中仍感怪异，内心矛盾弄得精神紧张，行为乖张，闹出不少笑话；万在夏平安产子前后，屡有奇异幻想，误会连场，猜疑甚多，更怀疑夏与任职于夏威夷精子银行的表哥潘震伟有染，不是人工受孕，而是被人受孕。

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: 除暴安良
programme.desc: 三名持枪劫匪抢劫了一批正在运送的新发行货币，刑警常勇奉命展开调查。随着线索逐渐浮现，常勇成功击毙一名劫匪。然而，其他两名劫匪不甘就此罢手，乘乱密谋抢劫金厂的黄金。常勇凭藉精密的部署，成功粉碎了他们的计划，将不法分子绳之以法。

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: 看不见的他们
programme.desc: 一场车祸后，林月家里怪事连连。全身冰冷的姐姐在镜子里看不见家人的身影，黑夜里爸爸窥探的双眼，和每天凌晨阁楼传来的弹珠声。林月循声而上去寻找真相，却在打开阁楼的门后，发现里面紧锁的是自己的遗像…

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: 珠光宝气
programme.desc: 一名商人的私生女，无意中擦出神仙阿宝，并得到三个愿望。可惜阿宝法术不精，而发生了很多啼笑皆非的事。

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao’s house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao’s descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: 风流冤鬼
programme.desc: 红歌女阿花遭大户陶老爷奸杀，陶宅即常闹鬼，后陶老爷亦神秘死亡。陶之后人陶明嗜赌如命，更因鬼魂作怪而欠下钜款。明妻暗中将陶宅售予杨教授夫妇，即遇上怪事连篇...

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: 再见七日情
programme.desc: 护卫员阿逊被派往保护富商的儿子，期间巧遇住在隔壁的祖儿，更渐渐爱上她，却发现原来祖儿是富商的情妇。当他俩的恋情被富商发现后，事情一发不可收拾！

programme.title: Mr Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Buddhist monk and Taoist priest put aside their differences to take on vampires that have been struck by lightning and have now become a super powered threat to mankind.

programme.title: 僵尸叔叔
programme.desc: 偏僻山间，一僧一道比邻而居。和尚（午马 饰）随和开朗，更有一女徒菁菁（李丽珍 饰）玲珑可爱；道士（陈友 饰）古板严厉，而徒弟嘉乐（钱嘉乐 饰）却鬼马顽皮。性格不同的两个师傅口角不断，大斗其法，两个冤家徒弟也搞笑连连，笑料频出。

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Bodyguard Long Wei has post‐traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm’s VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

programme.title: 虚拟特攻
programme.desc: 金牌保镖龙威在妻子惨死后患上了创伤后应激障碍，心情低落。他意外结识高科技公司职员Amy，在她邀请下参加了新产品的虚拟测试。龙威测试成功后即成为该公司的虚拟特攻，更获试用新发明的防护机甲，不料遭遇神秘武装人员入侵，一场生死大战即将展开…

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister’s daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man…

programme.title: 天官赐福
programme.desc: 康熙少年嗣位，太后急欲替他完婚，遂选纳大臣之女纳兰琼瑶为妃，但琼瑶为争取婚姻自由离家出走，康熙亦乐得不用成婚。后来康熙微服下江南，却偶遇女扮男装的琼瑶…

programme.title: Global Watch
programme.desc: GLOBAL WATCH is a 60 minute-long news program. The show stresses Chinese elements, emphasizing China’s perspective, policies and stories. The program, relying on global reporting resources, presents in-depth analysis and coverage of major global issues, from a Chinese perspective on international affairs. The program presents to-the-point interpretation of Chinese policies and stories that are of interest to foreign audiences, in a style they are familiar with.

programme.title: 江湖见
programme.desc: 常言道「读万卷书不如行万里路」。黎耀祥、麦长青再次踏上旅程，继续访寻金庸先生笔下的锦绣山河，探索华夏历史中的江湖世界。他们沿长江与黄河流域游历，穿梭四川、浙江、河南、山西等地，登峨眉金顶、游白帝城、访朱仙镇岳飞庙、探嵩山少林寺，既感受历史古迹的厚重，也品尝当地特色美食。江湖不仅是刀光剑影的舞台，更是人情交错的场域。他们在旅程中亦相约米雪、陈浩民、樊少皇、吕颂贤再度聚首，忆述昔日合作点滴，笑谈往事。

programme.desc: Good Morning Hong Kong brings you the latest news about Hong Kong, cross-strait, and international affairs that matter to you.

programme.title: 香港早晨 及 世界观
programme.desc: 报道香港、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: EMISSARY
programme.desc: Jiang Dawei, an idealistic student turned police officer, goes undercover to infiltrate a drug lord's inner circle. As he gathers evidence, his personality drastically changes, causing rifts with loved ones. He endures isolation and hardship to fulfill his duty.

programme.title: 猎鹰
programme.desc: 江大伟理想青年投身警界，受训成警后奉命被陷革职卧底毒枭，表面变节暗中取证。因身份巨变遭父亲、亲友与女友误解，孤立无援，尽显警务人员的艰辛与痛苦。

programme.title: Lo And Behold
programme.desc: Hung Shu-Kan owns a logistics business. The only thing on his mind is the well-being of his three daughters. His eldest daughter has moved abroad, but his second youngest daughter, Yuek-Shui, is still single. She and her little sister Sum-Yue often squabble, putting their father in a dilemma.

programme.title: 爱．回家之开心速递
programme.desc: 熊树根是小型运输公司东主，与次女若水、三女心如以及长女的儿子金城安同住旧楼，惟心如与若水经常争吵，教树根哭笑不得。树根无视众人反对，力邀不修边幅的亲弟树仁搬来同住，怎料树仁竟无意间招惹了鬼魂龙璟风，令熊家出现翻天覆地的转变！

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: This children's programme encourages children to ask questions, express themselves, and move towards their goals!

programme.title: Hands Up
programme.desc: 儿童节目《Hands Up》鼓励小朋友勇于发问，表达自我，向目标进发！吉祥物「酱汁家族」成员跟一众主持演出短剧，陪伴大家度过愉快时光。另会带来多首儿歌，让孩子们边唱边学习生活知识。

programme.title: Journey to Jianghu (SR.2) & What's On Today
programme.desc: As the saying goes, "Reading ten thousand books is not as good as traveling ten thousand miles." Wayne Lai and Mak Cheung-ching embark on another journey, continuing their exploration of the magnificent landscapes depicted in Jin Yong's novels and delving into the martial arts world of Chinese history. They travel along the Yangtze and Yellow River basins, traversing Sichuan, Zhejiang, Henan, and Shanxi provinces, climbing Mount Emei's Golden Summit, visiting Baidi City, the Yue Fei Temple in Zh

programme.title: 江湖见 & 今日知多D
programme.desc: 常言道「读万卷书不如行万里路」。黎耀祥、麦长青再次踏上旅程，继续访寻金庸先生笔下的锦绣山河，探索华夏历史中的江湖世界。他们沿长江与黄河流域游历，穿梭四川、浙江、河南、山西等地，登峨眉金顶、游白帝城、访朱仙镇岳飞庙、探嵩山少林寺，既感受历史古迹的厚重，也品尝当地特色美食。江湖不仅是刀光剑影的舞台，更是人情交错的场域。他们在旅程中亦相约米雪、陈浩民、樊少皇、吕颂贤再度聚首，忆述昔日合作点滴，笑谈往事。

programme.title: The Joy Of Nature
programme.desc: Taiwan's camping destinations are breathtaking! Our hosts embark on a nature-themed healing trip, traversing Nantou, Kaohsiung, Taoyuan and other locations, delving into the Miaoli mountains, trying out forest cabins, luxury campervans, deluxe tents and more!

programme.title: 自然系女子旅行
programme.desc: 台湾露营胜地美不胜收！港女主持林映晖联同台湾三大女神林襄、张雅涵和黄上晏，来一趟自然系疗愈旅行。她们穿梭南投、高雄、桃园等地，深入苗栗山区，试遍森林小木屋、高级露营车、豪华帐篷、棒球场露营等。

programme.title: Deadly Sins
programme.desc: Exploring the darker side of human nature when desire spirals out of control, this drama revolves around the East New Territories Regional Crime Unit, which investigates a series of bizarre murder cases and uncovers shocking secrets.

programme.title: 非分之罪
programme.desc: 本剧探讨人性在欲望失控下的黑暗面。新界东重案组接连调查多宗离奇命案，包括无脸女尸、石棺禁恋、一亿杀机、危险游戏、肮脏的子弹和恐怖情人等案件。

programme.title: Country Spirit
programme.desc: KOO SAI LUNG (CHUN PUI) is the manager of a wine factory. He adopts his ex-girlfriend’s illegitimate son, SHUNG (LAM KA TUNG), out of kindness. SHUNG is cheerful and tolerates any kind of abuse. LUNG’s sister, YIU (TANG SHUI MAN), loves SHUNG. However, she cannot forget her former love KOU (TSANG WAI KUEN) who is dead.

programme.title: 酒是故乡醇
programme.desc: 古世龙(秦沛)乃酒厂当家，因顾念情义而收留旧情人的私生子阿纯(林家栋)。纯寄人篱下，饱受屈辱，幸其生性豁达，毫不介意任低微的「酒尾公」。世龙妹古瑶(邓萃雯)处处关怀纯，纯对瑶早生情愫，惜瑶念念不忘已逝世的蒸煮师傅裘真(曾伟权)，不能释怀。世龙独子桂生(马德钟)为国从军，音讯杳然，古家以为其已死，替他安排冥婚，新娘是以拉横水渡为生的黎顺风(佘诗曼)。顺风为人执着、硬朗，与古家上下皆合不来，幸得纯从旁劝解，人才像美酒经过蒸酿般越见醇厚。纯其后拜「火王」金吉祥(元华)为师；祥早期丧妻，与瑶同病相怜，发展成一对斗气冤家。世龙中风，古家内部争权夺利，闹得天翻地覆，风只好以大少奶身分担起当家之位，与纯合力助酒厂渡过难关。二人日久生情，岂料生却于此时突然回家。风已为人妻，纯重情义，二人能否冲破沉重的道德枷锁，以真爱酿出醉人美酒？

programme.title: My Unfair Lady
programme.desc: Career driven LING MAN (Jessica Hester Hsuan) is a property management executive with a golden touch, and the shopping malls under her leadership have won many awards. She is also a control freak. As her number one assistant, her cousin LING YU-KEN (Natalie Tong) is totally under her thumb and hard-working. She learns to flirt superficially, helping LING MAN smooth over many problems. Just as LING MAN is looking forward to moving up the company to be appointed to the board of directors, the comp

programme.title: 不懂撒娇的女人
programme.desc: 点石成金的商场管理界女强人凌敏(宣萱)旗下商场获奖无数，更是个超级控制狂，堂妹凌禹勤(唐诗咏)作为她的头号助手，唯命是从、任劳任怨，更练出「伪撒娇」本领，为凌敏摆平不少麻烦。正当凌敏事业得意，有望晋身董事局时，公司竟请来商场推广界鬼才文念深(林文龙)与她平起平坐！这对爱恨交缠的前度情人在职场大斗法，凌敏不惜起用绰号「上海撒破郎」的美女实习生田蜜(高海宁)接近念深以套取情报，岂料田蜜不但觊觎凌敏的事业，更看上她的男人，两女展开激烈斗争！另一边，禹勤揭发花心男友何志超(黎诺懿)北上出轨，在灰心之时遇上最情深的暖男程日晖(王浩信)，以为能与他修成正果，却杀出个甜美温柔的台湾表妹向他表白，禹勤马上相形见拙！更糟糕的是，日晖似乎对婚姻异常恐惧，以结婚为志愿的禹勤，是否嫁杏无期？这对不懂撒娇、能干强悍的堂姊妹，最终是否能扭转厄运，获得幸福？

programme.title: Communion
programme.desc: After getting divorced, Au Yiu-cho (Kwok Chun On) and Tang Lai-kuen (Alice Chan) operate two restaurants coincidentally called Yuet Tak House in Hong Kong and on the mainland respectively. They never have issues with each other. In 2022, Lai-kuen abruptly returns to Hong Kong to open a branch. She even declares she wants to obtain the rights to the Yuet Tak House trademark through legal channels. The duo’s little son Au Ka-kin (Chow Ka Lok) signs up for Greater Bay Area Youth Entrepreneurship Co

programme.title: 回归
programme.desc: 区耀祖(郭晋安饰)和邓丽娟(陈炜饰)离婚后，各自在香港、内地经营菜馆粤德居，多年来相安无事。2022年，丽娟突然回港开设分店，更扬言要透过法律途径争夺粤德居商标！两人的幼子区家健(周嘉洛饰)参加大湾区创业比赛，遇上了担任导师的哥哥区家谦(吴伟豪饰)，还有对手张莱(戴祖仪饰)，却从磨擦与打击中加深认识，并携手创建出元宇宙粤德居。实体店和元宇宙的粤德居同样被控侵权，耀祖、丽娟、家健、家谦面临不同难关，一家人之间的连系，又能否令彼此关系回到最初的幸福温馨？

programme.title: Guts of Man
programme.desc: TUNG FEI (CHAN KIN FUNG, SAMMUL) ignores his late father’s last will and sneaks out of the Taohua Village, where he grew up, without his sister LAM’s (KOI MING FAI, JOYCE) knowing it. He meets a fisherman’s son SHEUNG FOON (NG CHEUK HAI, RON) on the way. He and FOON travel to the Qiantang River to see the tides. They meet a tycoon’s daughter YING HIU SUET (CHO, MANDY LEE) and FEI falls in love with her at first sight.

programme.title: 肝胆昆仑
programme.desc: 董斐(陈键锋)不理亡父遗训，乘姊姊岚(盖鸣晖)不觉时偷走出自幼居住的桃花村，途中结识了渔家子常欢(吴卓羲)。斐、欢到钱塘江观潮，斐对富家女邢晓雪(曹敏莉)一见钟情。岚、斐意外发现父亲当年含冤而逝，为了为父讨回清白，二人在杭州住下。岚因调查而认识了佯装搭棚工人的节衡都尉狄英伟(元华)。伟义兄为沧洲五鬼所杀，伟为了方便调查而一直隐藏身分。调查下来，原来岚父之死，与沧洲五鬼及雪父均环环相扣。另方面，斐、欢因为雪而闹翻，斐更因利欲熏心而重创岚……

programme.title: Provocateur
programme.desc: Following deaths of his first and second wife, cosmetic mogul CHEUK KWAN-LAM (Gallen Lo), who is left alone living with his step-daughter CHEUK MAN-LEI (Jacqueline Wong), tries to turn over a new leaf. As fate would have it, he encounters a resourceful young man called POON SIU-KIT (Fred Cheng), through whom he sees a younger version of himself, so he cannot help developing a kindly feeling for him. His secretary CHAN HEI-MAN (Ali Lee) also has a very high regard for SIU-KIT after he joins the c

programme.title: 与谍同谋
programme.desc: 坐拥美容事业王国的卓君临(罗嘉良)两任妻子相继离世，剩下继女卓敏莉(黄心颖)共同生活，渐渐开始寻索人生的下半场，他遇见了足智多谋的年青人潘少杰(郑俊弘)，君临在他身上看见少年时候的自己，份外有一种亲切感，其贴身秘书陈唏文(李佳芯)也特别赏识这位新入职的市场部经理，确知他必能带领公司更上一层楼；唏文自丈夫康逸风(曹永廉)无故失踪多年，一直用工作麻醉自己，渐渐将君临和公司的一切成为她的人生目标。少杰表面积极讨好君临和取得唏文的信任，但背后与几位各有专长的伙伴，包括善长收集情报凌晋(张颕康)、社交能手邹佩瑜(汤洛雯)、科技宅女杜志仁(赖慰玲)和变装达人林信辉(胡诺言)，合作偷窃各大财团的商业秘密作为生财工具，已部署多年的少杰，正等待最佳时机发动一次摧毁性的报复行动，一场犹如父子的角力就在无形的战场上慢慢展开……

programme.title: Country Spirit
programme.desc: KOO SAI LUNG (CHUN PUI) is the manager of a wine factory. He adopts his ex-girlfriend’s illegitimate son, SHUNG (LAM KA TUNG), out of kindness. SHUNG is cheerful and tolerates any kind of abuse. LUNG’s sister, YIU (TANG SHUI MAN), loves SHUNG. However, she cannot forget her former love KOU (TSANG WAI KUEN) who is dead.

programme.title: 酒是故乡醇
programme.desc: 古世龙(秦沛)乃酒厂当家，因顾念情义而收留旧情人的私生子阿纯(林家栋)。纯寄人篱下，饱受屈辱，幸其生性豁达，毫不介意任低微的「酒尾公」。世龙妹古瑶(邓萃雯)处处关怀纯，纯对瑶早生情愫，惜瑶念念不忘已逝世的蒸煮师傅裘真(曾伟权)，不能释怀。世龙独子桂生(马德钟)为国从军，音讯杳然，古家以为其已死，替他安排冥婚，新娘是以拉横水渡为生的黎顺风(佘诗曼)。顺风为人执着、硬朗，与古家上下皆合不来，幸得纯从旁劝解，人才像美酒经过蒸酿般越见醇厚。纯其后拜「火王」金吉祥(元华)为师；祥早期丧妻，与瑶同病相怜，发展成一对斗气冤家。世龙中风，古家内部争权夺利，闹得天翻地覆，风只好以大少奶身分担起当家之位，与纯合力助酒厂渡过难关。二人日久生情，岂料生却于此时突然回家。风已为人妻，纯重情义，二人能否冲破沉重的道德枷锁，以真爱酿出醉人美酒？

programme.title: My Unfair Lady
programme.desc: Career driven LING MAN (Jessica Hester Hsuan) is a property management executive with a golden touch, and the shopping malls under her leadership have won many awards. She is also a control freak. As her number one assistant, her cousin LING YU-KEN (Natalie Tong) is totally under her thumb and hard-working. She learns to flirt superficially, helping LING MAN smooth over many problems. Just as LING MAN is looking forward to moving up the company to be appointed to the board of directors, the comp

programme.title: 不懂撒娇的女人
programme.desc: 点石成金的商场管理界女强人凌敏(宣萱)旗下商场获奖无数，更是个超级控制狂，堂妹凌禹勤(唐诗咏)作为她的头号助手，唯命是从、任劳任怨，更练出「伪撒娇」本领，为凌敏摆平不少麻烦。正当凌敏事业得意，有望晋身董事局时，公司竟请来商场推广界鬼才文念深(林文龙)与她平起平坐！这对爱恨交缠的前度情人在职场大斗法，凌敏不惜起用绰号「上海撒破郎」的美女实习生田蜜(高海宁)接近念深以套取情报，岂料田蜜不但觊觎凌敏的事业，更看上她的男人，两女展开激烈斗争！另一边，禹勤揭发花心男友何志超(黎诺懿)北上出轨，在灰心之时遇上最情深的暖男程日晖(王浩信)，以为能与他修成正果，却杀出个甜美温柔的台湾表妹向他表白，禹勤马上相形见拙！更糟糕的是，日晖似乎对婚姻异常恐惧，以结婚为志愿的禹勤，是否嫁杏无期？这对不懂撒娇、能干强悍的堂姊妹，最终是否能扭转厄运，获得幸福？

programme.title: Communion
programme.desc: After getting divorced, Au Yiu-cho (Kwok Chun On) and Tang Lai-kuen (Alice Chan) operate two restaurants coincidentally called Yuet Tak House in Hong Kong and on the mainland respectively. They never have issues with each other. In 2022, Lai-kuen abruptly returns to Hong Kong to open a branch. She even declares she wants to obtain the rights to the Yuet Tak House trademark through legal channels. The duo’s little son Au Ka-kin (Chow Ka Lok) signs up for Greater Bay Area Youth Entrepreneurship Co

programme.title: 回归
programme.desc: 区耀祖(郭晋安饰)和邓丽娟(陈炜饰)离婚后，各自在香港、内地经营菜馆粤德居，多年来相安无事。2022年，丽娟突然回港开设分店，更扬言要透过法律途径争夺粤德居商标！两人的幼子区家健(周嘉洛饰)参加大湾区创业比赛，遇上了担任导师的哥哥区家谦(吴伟豪饰)，还有对手张莱(戴祖仪饰)，却从磨擦与打击中加深认识，并携手创建出元宇宙粤德居。实体店和元宇宙的粤德居同样被控侵权，耀祖、丽娟、家健、家谦面临不同难关，一家人之间的连系，又能否令彼此关系回到最初的幸福温馨？

programme.title: Guts of Man
programme.desc: TUNG FEI (CHAN KIN FUNG, SAMMUL) ignores his late father’s last will and sneaks out of the Taohua Village, where he grew up, without his sister LAM’s (KOI MING FAI, JOYCE) knowing it. He meets a fisherman’s son SHEUNG FOON (NG CHEUK HAI, RON) on the way. He and FOON travel to the Qiantang River to see the tides. They meet a tycoon’s daughter YING HIU SUET (CHO, MANDY LEE) and FEI falls in love with her at first sight.

programme.desc: 董斐(陈键锋)不理亡父遗训，乘姊姊岚(盖鸣晖)不觉时偷走出自幼居住的桃花村，途中结识了渔家子常欢(吴卓羲)。斐、欢到钱塘江观潮，斐对富家女邢晓雪(曹敏莉)一见钟情。岚、斐意外发现父亲当年含冤而逝，为了为父讨回清白，二人在杭州住下。岚因调查而认识了佯装搭棚工人的节衡都尉狄英伟(元华)。伟义兄为沧洲五鬼所杀，伟为了方便调查而一直隐藏身分。调查下来，原来岚父之死，与沧洲五鬼及雪父均环环相扣。另方面，斐、欢因为雪而闹翻，斐更因利欲熏心而重创岚……

programme.title: Provocateur
programme.desc: Following deaths of his first and second wife, cosmetic mogul CHEUK KWAN-LAM (Gallen Lo), who is left alone living with his step-daughter CHEUK MAN-LEI (Jacqueline Wong), tries to turn over a new leaf. programme.title: 与谍同谋
programme.desc: 坐拥美容事业王国的卓君临(罗嘉良)两任妻子相继离世，剩下继女卓敏莉(黄心颖)共同生活，渐渐开始寻索人生的下半场，他遇见了足智多谋的年青人潘少杰(郑俊弘)，君临在他身上看见少年时候的自己，份外有一种亲切感，其贴身秘书陈唏文(李佳芯)也特别赏识这位新入职的市场部经理，确知他必能带领公司更上一层楼；唏文自丈夫康逸风(曹永廉)无故失踪多年，一直用工作麻醉自己，渐渐将君临和公司的一切成为她的人生目标。少杰表面积极讨好君临和取得唏文的信任，但背后与几位各有专长的伙伴，包括善长收集情报凌晋(张颕康)、社交能手邹佩瑜(汤洛雯)、科技宅女杜志仁(赖慰玲)和变装达人林信辉(胡诺言)，合作偷窃各大财团的商业秘密作为生财工具，已部署多年的少杰，正等待最佳时机发动一次摧毁性的报复行动，一场犹如父子的角力就在无形的战场上慢慢展开……

programme.title: Country Spirit
programme.desc: KOO SAI LUNG (CHUN PUI) is the manager of a wine factory. He adopts his ex-girlfriend’s illegitimate son, SHUNG (LAM KA TUNG), out of kindness. SHUNG is cheerful and tolerates any kind of abuse. LUNG’s sister, YIU (TANG SHUI MAN), loves SHUNG. However, she cannot forget her former love KOU (TSANG WAI KUEN) who is dead.

programme.title: 酒是故乡醇
programme.desc: 古世龙(秦沛)乃酒厂当家，因顾念情义而收留旧情人的私生子阿纯(林家栋)。纯寄人篱下，饱受屈辱，幸其生性豁达，毫不介意任低微的「酒尾公」。世龙妹古瑶(邓萃雯)处处关怀纯，纯对瑶早生情愫，惜瑶念念不忘已逝世的蒸煮师傅裘真(曾伟权)，不能释怀。世龙独子桂生(马德钟)为国从军，音讯杳然，古家以为其已死，替他安排冥婚，新娘是以拉横水渡为生的黎顺风(佘诗曼)。顺风为人执着、硬朗，与古家上下皆合不来，幸得纯从旁劝解，人才像美酒经过蒸酿般越见醇厚。纯其后拜「火王」金吉祥(元华)为师；祥早期丧妻，与瑶同病相怜，发展成一对斗气冤家。世龙中风，古家内部争权夺利，闹得天翻地覆，风只好以大少奶身分担起当家之位，与纯合力助酒厂渡过难关。二人日久生情，岂料生却于此时突然回家。风已为人妻，纯重情义，二人能否冲破沉重的道德枷锁，以真爱酿出醉人美酒？

programme.title: My Unfair Lady
programme.desc: Career driven LING MAN (Jessica Hester Hsuan) is a property management executive with a golden touch, and the shopping malls under her leadership have won many awards. She is also a control freak. As her number one assistant, her cousin LING YU-KEN (Natalie Tong) is totally under her thumb and hard-working. She learns to flirt superficially, helping LING MAN smooth over many problems. Just as LING MAN is looking forward to moving up the company to be appointed to the board of directors, the comp

programme.title: 不懂撒娇的女人
programme.desc: 点石成金的商场管理界女强人凌敏(宣萱)旗下商场获奖无数，更是个超级控制狂，堂妹凌禹勤(唐诗咏)作为她的头号助手，唯命是从、任劳任怨，更练出「伪撒娇」本领，为凌敏摆平不少麻烦。正当凌敏事业得意，有望晋身董事局时，公司竟请来商场推广界鬼才文念深(林文龙)与她平起平坐！这对爱恨交缠的前度情人在职场大斗法，凌敏不惜起用绰号「上海撒破郎」的美女实习生田蜜(高海宁)接近念深以套取情报，岂料田蜜不但觊觎凌敏的事业，更看上她的男人，两女展开激烈斗争！另一边，禹勤揭发花心男友何志超(黎诺懿)北上出轨，在灰心之时遇上最情深的暖男程日晖(王浩信)，以为能与他修成正果，却杀出个甜美温柔的台湾表妹向他表白，禹勤马上相形见拙！更糟糕的是，日晖似乎对婚姻异常恐惧，以结婚为志愿的禹勤，是否嫁杏无期？这对不懂撒娇、能干强悍的堂姊妹，最终是否能扭转厄运，获得幸福？

programme.title: Communion
programme.desc: After getting divorced, Au Yiu-cho (Kwok Chun On) and Tang Lai-kuen (Alice Chan) operate two restaurants coincidentally called Yuet Tak House in Hong Kong and on the mainland respectively. They never have issues with each other. In 2022, Lai-kuen abruptly returns to Hong Kong to open a branch. She even declares she wants to obtain the rights to the Yuet Tak House trademark through legal channels. The duo’s little son Au Ka-kin (Chow Ka Lok) signs up for Greater Bay Area Youth Entrepreneurship Co

programme.title: 回归
programme.desc: 区耀祖(郭晋安饰)和邓丽娟(陈炜饰)离婚后，各自在香港、内地经营菜馆粤德居，多年来相安无事。2022年，丽娟突然回港开设分店，更扬言要透过法律途径争夺粤德居商标！两人的幼子区家健(周嘉洛饰)参加大湾区创业比赛，遇上了担任导师的哥哥区家谦(吴伟豪饰)，还有对手张莱(戴祖仪饰)，却从磨擦与打击中加深认识，并携手创建出元宇宙粤德居。实体店和元宇宙的粤德居同样被控侵权，耀祖、丽娟、家健、家谦面临不同难关，一家人之间的连系，又能否令彼此关系回到最初的幸福温馨？

programme.title: Guts of Man
programme.desc: TUNG FEI (CHAN KIN FUNG, SAMMUL) ignores his late father’s last will and sneaks out of the Taohua Village, where he grew up, without his sister LAM’s (KOI MING FAI, JOYCE) knowing it. He meets a fisherman’s son SHEUNG FOON (NG CHEUK HAI, RON) on the way. He and FOON travel to the Qiantang River to see the tides. They meet a tycoon’s daughter YING HIU SUET (CHO, MANDY LEE) and FEI falls in love with her at first sight.
